topics.title: Metalyse — AIS Late Window (TENACITY) Study Design and Competitor Landscape

background.text: CDE written feedback (Stat, CP, Clinical) received in Apr; clarification question on dosing scheme to CDE CP still open. EMA final written feedback received in May. Key considerations on study design: (1) time window (to further discuss at this MAP), (2) dosing scheme, (3) double-blind design. Steer committee meeting to be held during ESOC. Competitor Mingfule-CSPC late time window (4.5–24h) registration trial obtained CTA permission in Apr 2024.

Pipeline summary shows Metalyse AIS (>4.5h) TENACITY: Next Milestone RoS, Timeline TBD, China NDA Approval (best case) 2029-Jun, Global status: To start Ph III (2025-Dec), China Status: To join Ph III.
